title: 기는 하지만
part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태
articleMarkdown:
#### En pocas palabras

The NIKL teacher’s guide explains **-기는 하지만** as partially acknowledging a fact before adding a different or contrasting aspect. Its examples include **예쁘기는 하지만 너무 비싸요** and **김치를 담글 수 있기는 하지만 잘 못해요**. The guide also marks a change-of-topic continuation as unsuitable in one example, so this entry limits the construction to same-topic partial concession/contrast with a relevant second aspect.

#### Fuentes y localizadores

Teacher’s Guide, lesson “-기는 하다,” box 알아볼까요 and usage/functional notes: form -기는 하지만; examples 예쁘기는 하지만 너무 비싸요 / 김치를 담글 수 있기는 하지만 잘 못해요; same-topic contrast examples and one counterexample.

#### Entradas relacionadas

Se relaciona con **-지만**, **하지만** y otras construcciones concesivas. También guarda relación con usos contrastivos de **은/는**, porque el componente **는** contribuye a presentar la primera idea como punto reconocido frente a la segunda.
